newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere shares mixed on lower turnover.
newsitem.headline: Solidere shares mixed on lower turnover.

text.p: Solidere shares were mixed on lower turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday.
A shares rose slightly to $113.75 from $113.5 and B shares fell to $114 from $115.875.
Turnover was 5,656 shares from 6,952 on Wednesday and value was $643,375.25 from $787,711.
There was no trade for the fourth successive day in the shares of the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.20 percent to 82.47 and the BLOM stock index fell 0.64 percent to 957.72.
